name: signup-validation-error-handling
hook: Signup form validation needs try-catch to prevent silent failures
body: The validateSignupForm function in SignupForm.tsx should be wrapped in try-catch to handle edge cases where it might throw or return unexpected results. Without this, validation failures can silently propagate and users see no error messages.
why: The bug manifested as 'silent' failures - no errors shown. Adding defensive error handling ensures at minimum a toast error appears if validation itself throws.
